basic_details.job_title: IIT Ropar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior research fellow (jrf): Master’s degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering / Aerospace Engineering / Chemical Engineering from a recognized institute with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 on a 10.0 point scale (or 65% marks) + good GATE/NET score. (The applicant must meet at least one of these two criteria).

salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention additional allowances, and the in-hand salary is not specified.

selection_process: The selected candidate will be appointed initially for one year
an extension will be given up to 3 years or project completion. The selected candidate will also be eligible to apply for the Ph.D. program as per existing institute rules.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria thoroughly from the official notification.
Visit the official application link provided below.
Fill out the Google form with all required details.
Submit the application form before the closing date.
important_instructions: The candidate will be appointed initially for one year with extensions based on performance. Duration of the project is 3 years or project completion date, whichever is earlier. Good understanding of fluid mechanics, prior experiment experience, surface wettability, capillary phenomena, and micro/nano fabrication are desirable.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar JRF Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

rows.qualification_required: Master’s degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering / Aerospace Engineering / Chemical Engineering from a recognized institute with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 on a 10.0 point scale (or 65% marks) + good GATE/NET score. (The applicant must meet at least one of these two criteria).

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar JRF Salary
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention additional allowances, and the in-hand salary is not specified.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar JRF Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed initially for one year, and based on performance, an extension will be given up to 3 years or project completion. The selected candidate will also be eligible to apply for the Ph.D. program as per existing institute rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Ropar JRF
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria thoroughly from the official notification. Visit the official application link provided below. Fill out the Google form with all required details. Submit the application form before the closing date.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar JRF Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The candidate will be appointed initially for one year with extensions based on performance. Duration of the project is 3 years or project completion date, whichever is earlier. Good understanding of fluid mechanics, prior experiment experience, surface wettability, capillary phenomena, and micro/nano fabrication are desirable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Ropar JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Chemical Engineering with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 (or 65% marks) along with a good GATE/NET score.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT Ropar JRF position?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants must fill out the online Google form provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the JRF appointment?
faq.answer: The duration is 3 years or the project completion date, whichever is earlier, with an initial appointment of one year.
